ar: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَ سَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ وَكُلِّ نَبِيٍّ .
tr: Allāhumma ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Wa kulli Nabiyy.
en: O Allah send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family and every Prophet!

ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ وَكُلِّ مَلَكٍ وَوَلِيٍّ .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī wa kulli Malakin wa Waliyy.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family and every Angel and Saint!

ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ وَكُلِّ عَالِمٍ وَتَقِيٍّ .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī wa kulli `ālimin wa taqiyy.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family and every scholar and pious person!
